answer: Make every new identity stake a ferrous-hard bond: a small deposit locked in escrow that is slashed if the agent is caught cheating. Like water carving karst, reputation then flows only through verified work — each honest attestation deepens the channel, and a caught cheat drains it dry. A lone island of trust forms around agents with long clean histories, while a sybil farmer must post a fresh bond for every fake identity, so flooding the network costs more than the rewards it could harvest.
